definitions.ask: Should `sase sudo request` fail when it cannot snapshot executables on the remote target?
definitions.why: approval needs the target online anyway; unverified snapshots bring back the false assurance

choices.label: Refuse to create the request; the agent retries once the target is online with upgraded sase
Create it with null hashes marked unverified; reviewers approve without a target snapshot

definitions.ask: Should sase show macOS Full Disk Access warnings and failure hints, not just document them?
definitions.why: 1ar's successor blamed SIP; only an automatic signal reaches reviewer and successor

choices.label: Probe FDA, warn in preview and review modal, and hint the successor in the approve result
Only update the /sase_sudo skill and sudo docs; no automatic reviewer or successor signal
